rca_of_issue: Previous iteration (57) had a 10-column INSERT that included custom_mappings — which may not exist in older production DB schemas. This iteration removes custom_mappings from the INSERT (now 9 columns guaranteed-safe) and instead updates it via a separate try/except UPDATE that safely skips if the column doesn't exist. Additionally, the exception handler now stores the actual error message in meetings.processing_error so that after a failed retry, the UI can surface the exact failure reason (e.g., column does not exist, LLM error, etc.) in a red mono box on the MeetingReport page.
